About the United States Of CJS City

National overview

One country, 55 states

The United States Of CJS City, abbreviated USCC and also called CJS City, is described in the project as an underwater country with its own government, capital, history, calendar and 55 states.

This website records the country's worldbuilding, chronology and national information as supplied by its creator. It distinguishes recorded project facts from details that have not yet been supplied.

City administration lore

Mayor and departments

Earlier project information names MrBeast as mayor of CJS City and Elon Musk as the person running its YouTube department.

The project information names the president and founder. A full cabinet, legislature, court system, election rules and department list have not yet been provided, so they are not invented here.

The 55 states of the USCC

The country has 55 states. Their official names and individual details have not all been supplied in the information available for this website.

National history and chronology

The following chronology preserves the dates and descriptions shared for the CJS City project. Some early events are described as attempts, plans or naming changes rather than completed independence.

1289

The first attempt to declare the country is recorded in the project history. It did not become independent at that point.

1399

The place was renamed “Vatican City” in the account shared, with a plan for a later development.

1469

Spain is stated to have already existed by this year in the project's chronology.

1587

A person attempted to claim the place and call it Spain, according to the account.

1606

The country became independent in the account, but did not yet have its final name; it was known as “Country City”.

1775

The official USCC independence year is given as 1775. Cara James Smith is named as the founder of USCC.

1891

The country received the “normal all-world calendar” in the account shared.

1934

The calendar was changed to the calendar system used in the project today.

A separate project statement describes CJS City as 738 years old in 2027, counting from the 1289 beginning. The project also identifies 1775 as the official USCC independence year; both dates are shown with their original meanings.

CJS City calendar and time

Calendar system

The project says its current calendar system dates from the change made in 1934.

Project date reference

A date shared on 12 November 2026 placed CJS City in December 2027.

Time difference statement

CJS City was described as ahead by 1 year, 1 month, 1 week, 1 day, 1 hour, 1 minute and 1 second.

Christmas date

A project-specific answer placed Christmas at 1:01 AM on 26 January 2028.

These are CJS City calendar rules and date statements from the project, not conversions to the standard Gregorian calendar.

National flag and identity

USCC flag

The supplied design has three horizontal fields: purple at the top, black in the middle and blue at the bottom, with large gold-and-white USCC lettering across the centre.

National name and abbreviation

Full name: United States Of CJS City

Abbreviation: USCC

Short name: CJS City

The word “Of” is part of the full country name. It is not added to the abbreviation.

Culture, music and community

🎵 Music

Music is part of the wider CJS City and Southworth creative world. The Southworth 3 and its releases have been discussed as part of the project's music history.

🎮 Games and creativity

Games, digital projects and creative media form part of the broader CJS Studios universe associated with CJS City.

🌊 Underwater setting

CJS City is described as an underwater country, with underwater life and city imagery central to its visual identity.

🏙️ CJS City and Earth

One earlier description calls CJS City the capital city of Earth and places it in the UK. The country's capital is separately named as CJS City Headquarters.
